product_one_liner.value: DataGrail is an AI-powered data privacy platform for privacy, legal, and security teams that automates privacy operations such as data discovery, consumer requests, consent, and risk management.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its platform as an AI-powered privacy platform and its public documentation covers privacy-program workflows and product modules.

pricing_page.notes: The site offers demo/contact and pricing inquiries but does not publish a pricing page with prices or plans; the contact form is an inquiry form.

named_customers.notes: Both names appear on DataGrail customer case-study or spotlight pages.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn displays 73 employees; Built In reports 95 total employees. Both fall in the 51-100 band.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn lists San Francisco, California as headquarters; Built In gives the San Francisco headquarters address.

founded_year.notes: Both company profile sources list 2018 as the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains privacy-industry, product-update, and company/marketing content, but does not show at least two engineering-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: DataGrail has a public documentation site with multiple product sections, integration instructions, changelogs, and API documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists four roles—Senior Customer Success Manager, Senior Product Marketing Manager, Senior Demand Generation Manager, and IT & Business Systems Manager—and none matches the specified AI/ML/data-science titles.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed DataGrail's Vera documentation, product/security materials, blog, and available trust/subprocessor information. These describe Vera's architecture and AI capabilities but do not identify the underlying model or provider used by the product.

compliance_certs.notes: DataGrail's security solution page says it is HIPAA compliant and has SOC 2 Type II. GDPR is mentioned as a regulation, not a claimed certification; Privacy Shield is not one of the requested values.

last_funding.notes: DataGrail's announcement dated October 12, 2022 says it closed a $45 million Series C, bringing total funding to $84.2 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round is the October 2022 Series C, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live careers page and Greenhouse board list four roles, none titled SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: The October 30, 2026 changelog entry presents new features, including importing Processing Activities from an existing RoPA and customizable Getting Started pages for assessment templates. This falls within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The full leadership listing is small and the press index shows no C-level or VP join/departure dated from November 9, 2025 through November 9, 2026; the listed executive personnel announcement is from 2022.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These systems are named on DataGrail's integration pages; categories include CRM, marketing automation, conversational marketing, and help desk.
